name: Ebihane Nui
source:
Bright and cheerful cat-eared girl, little sister type.

Saint Merhata Academy, 1st Year Class C. An innocent, bright, and energetic girl. She has a slightly Akiba-style hobby.

She wears her favorite cat ears and tail. Due to her childlike speech, actions, and appearance, she is doted on like a little sister by those around her.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/turibaka/]official site[/url]]
